dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-contrast perimeters forming predominantly closed 'O' shapes with a sharp gradient transition from light-grey/white borders to dark-pixel centers; most prominent structures are distributed along the mid-dorsal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-grey pixel clusters without internal gradients localized in the anterior dorsal region and near the shoulder transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular convex quadrilateral with a longitudinal axis roughly parallel to the animal's spine.
